abilities.description: Gragas samples his latest brew for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes boisterous and belligerent, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.
abilities.tooltip: Gragas samples his brew, reducing incoming damage by {{ damagereduction }} for {{ defenseduration }} seconds and empowering his next Attack to deal an additional {{ totaldamage }} plus {{ maxhppercentdamage }}% max Health magic damage to the target and surrounding enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Body Slam
abilities.description: Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.
abilities.tooltip: Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy, Knocking Up nearby enemies for {{ stunduration }} second and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to them. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ cooldownrefund*100 }}% if Gragas collides with an enemy.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Explosive Cask
abilities.description: Gragas hurls his cask to a location, dealing damage and knocking back enemies caught in the blast radius.
abilities.tooltip: Gragas hurls his cask, dealing {{ damagedone }} magic damage and Knocking Away enemies from the impact zone.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Assassin's Mark
abilities.description: Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage.

abilities.name: Five Point Strike
abilities.description: Akali throws out five kunai, dealing damage based on her bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power and slowing.
abilities.tooltip: Akali slings kunai in an arc, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and Slowing enemies at the tip by {{ slowpercentage*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Twilight Shroud
abilities.description: Akali drops a cover of smoke and briefly gains Move Speed. While inside the shroud, Akali becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.
abilities.tooltip: Akali drops a smoke bomb, unleashing a spreading cover of smoke lasting {{ baseduration }} seconds and granting herself {{ movementspeed }}% Move Speed decaying over {{ movementspeedduration }} seconds. Akali increases her max Energy by {{ energyrestore }} while the shroud is active. While inside the smoke, Akali is Invisible .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shuriken Flip
abilities.description: Flip backward and fire a shuriken forward, dealing magic damage. The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target, dealing additional damage.
abilities.tooltip: Akali flips backwards as she throws a shuriken, dealing {{ e1damage }} magic damage and marking the first enemy or smoke cloud hit. Akali can Recast this once to dash to the marked target, dealing {{ e2damagecalc }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Perfect Execution
abilities.description: Akali leaps in a direction, damaging enemies she strikes. Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.
abilities.tooltip: Akali vaults over an enemy champion, dealing {{ cast1damage }} magic damage to all enemies in her path. Akali can Recast after {{ cooldownbetweencasts }} seconds to execute a piercing thrust, dashing and dealing {{ cast2damagemin }} to {{ cast2damagemax }} magic damage based on missing Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Icathian Surprise
abilities.description: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Caustic Spittle
abilities.description: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Kog'Maw gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed . Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds {{ shredamount }}% Armor and Magic Resist for {{ shredduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
abilities.description: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage.
abilities.tooltip: Kog'Maw gains {{ range }} Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional {{ totalhealthdamage }} max Health magic damage for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Ooze
abilities.description: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.
abilities.tooltip: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and leaving a trail of ooze for {{ trailduration }} seconds. Enemies in the ooze are Slowed by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Living Artillery
abilities.description: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.
abilities.tooltip: Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing {{ basedamagecalc }} plus {{ tooltipmissinghealthdamageamp }}% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take {{ maxdamagecalc }} magic damage . Subsequent shots within {{ manacostduration }} seconds cost an additional {{ basecost }} Mana (max: {{ manacostcap }} Mana ).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.description: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.

abilities.name: Sear
abilities.description: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.
abilities.tooltip: Brand launches a fireball that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target is Ablaze , they will be Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Pillar of Flame
abilities.description: After a short delay, Brand creates a Pillar of Flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take an additional 25% damage.
abilities.tooltip: Brand creates a pillar of pure fire, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Units that are Ablaze take {{ empowereddamage }} damage instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Conflagration
abilities.description: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target that spreads to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread is doubled.
abilities.tooltip: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing {{ edamagecalc }} magic damage to surrounding units. If the target is Ablaze , the spread range is doubled.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Pyroclasm
abilities.description: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that bounces up to 5 times off of Brand and nearby enemies, dealing magic damage to enemies each time bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on Champions. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will briefly slow them.
abilities.tooltip: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that can bounce to Brand or another enemy up to 5 times, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies each bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on champions. If the target is Ablaze , they are briefly Slowed by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fury of the North
abilities.description: After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows. Frost Armor persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage.  Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.

abilities.name: Arctic Assault
abilities.description: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion.
abilities.tooltip: Sejuani charges, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage to enemies and Knocking them Up for {{ e4 }} seconds. The charge ends after hitting an enemy champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Winter's Wrath
abilities.description: Sejuani swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks.
abilities.tooltip: Sejuani swings her flail, dealing {{ firsthitdamagetooltip }} physical damage and Knocking Back minions and jungle monsters. She then lashes out again, dealing {{ secondhitdamagetooltip }} physical damage and briefly Slowing targets. Both swings apply stacks of Permafrost .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Permafrost
abilities.description: Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Nearby melee allied champions' Attacks apply a stack to champions and jungle monsters. Active: Sejuani deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to target enemy with 4 stacks and Stuns them for {{ e1 }} second. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Glacial Prison
abilities.description: Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Sejuani throws her True Ice bola, Stunning and revealing the first enemy champion hit for {{ e2 }} second and dealing {{ minordamagetooltip }} magic damage . If the bola travels at least 25% of its range, it Stuns and reveals for {{ e6 }} seconds instead. It then also creates an ice storm that Slows surrounding enemies by {{ e4 }}% for {{ e3 }} seconds. All affected enemies take {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Eternal Hunger
abilities.description: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.

abilities.name: Jaws of the Beast
abilities.description: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.
abilities.tooltip: Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing {{ basebitedamage }} plus {{ targetpercenthpdamage }}% max Health magic damage and healing for {{ e3 }}% of the damage dealt . Hold: Warwick lunges and clamps his jaws on the target, leaping behind them. While clamped, Warwick follows all movement of the target. After releasing his hold, he does the same damage and healing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blood Hunt
abilities.description: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Warwick can sense champions below 50% Health, gaining {{ passivemsbonus }}% Move Speed towards them. Spells and attacks against enemies below 50% Health grant {{ passiveasbonus }}% Attack Speed . These effects are increased by 200% against enemies below 25% Health. Active: Warwick can briefly sense all enemies, and gains this Ability's passive effect against the closest champion for 8 seconds, regardless of Health. If no champions are found, this Ability's cooldown is reduced by 30%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Primal Howl
abilities.description: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.
abilities.tooltip: Warwick gains {{ e1 }}% damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. After it ends, Warwick howls, Fearing nearby enemies for {{ e3 }} second. Warwick can Recast to end the Ability early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Infinite Duress
abilities.description: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.
abilities.tooltip: Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his Move Speed , Suppressing the first champion he collides with while he channels for {{ rduration }} seconds. He attacks that champion 3 times over the duration, dealing {{ damagecumulative }} magic damage . Warwick heals for 100% of all damage dealt during the channel.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Second Skin
abilities.description: Kai'Sa's basic attacks stack Plasma, dealing increasing bonus magic damage. Allies' immobilizing effects help stack Plasma. Additionally, Kai'Sa's item purchases upgrade her basic spells to have more powerful properties.

abilities.name: Icathian Rain
abilities.description: Kai'Sa shoots a swarm of missiles that seek out nearby targets. Living Weapon: Icathian Rain is upgraded to shoot more missiles.
abilities.tooltip: Kai'Sa launches {{ e2 }} missiles that split among nearby enemies, each dealing {{ totalindividualmissiledamage }} physical damage , up to a maximum of {{ maxdamagedisplay }}. Additional missile hits on champions or monsters deal {{ extrahitreduction*100 }}% damage. Evolved : Kai'Sa instead fires {{ e7 }} missiles. Current: {{ f11.1 }}/{{ e6 }} Bonus Attack Damage {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Seeker
abilities.description: Kai'Sa shoots a long range missile, marking enemies with her passive. Living Weapon: Void Seeker is upgraded to apply more passive marks and reduce cooldown on champion hit.
abilities.tooltip: Kai'Sa fires a void blast that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage , applies {{ e4 }} stacks of Plasma , and grants True Sight of the first enemy hit for {{ spell.kaisapassive:pduration }} seconds. Evolved : Kai'Sa instead applies {{ e5 }} stacks of Plasma and hitting a champion reduces the Cooldown by {{ e3 }}%. Current: {{ f2.1 }}/{{ e2 }} Ability Power {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Supercharge
abilities.description: Kai'Sa briefly increases her Move Speed, then increases her Attack Speed. Living Weapon: Supercharge is upgraded to briefly grant Invisibility.
abilities.tooltip: Kai'Sa supercharges her void energy, gaining {{ totalmovespeed }} Move Speed and becoming Ghosted while charging, then gaining {{ e5 }}% Attack Speed for {{ e2 }} seconds. Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ e4 }} seconds. Evolved : Kai'Sa also becomes Invisible for {{ e7 }} seconds. Current: {{ f10.1 }}%/{{ e6 }}% Bonus Attack Speed {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Killer Instinct
abilities.description: Kai'Sa dashes near an enemy champion.
abilities.tooltip: Kai'Sa warps near an enemy champion affected by Plasma and gains {{ rcalculatedshieldvalue }} Shield for {{ rshieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
abilities.description: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.

abilities.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
abilities.description: Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.
abilities.tooltip: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within {{ buffduration }} seconds gain {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed and deal an additional {{ totaldamagetooltip }} physical damage to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
abilities.description: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains {{ burrowedmovespeed }} Move Speed , {{ visionradiusmod*-100 }}% reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
abilities.description: Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.
abilities.tooltip: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing {{ spell.reksaie:basedamage }} physical damage . At max Fury , the bite deals {{ spell.reksaie:empowereddamage }} true damage instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Rush
abilities.description: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.
abilities.tooltip: Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last {{ preymarkduration }} seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing {{ rbasedamagecalc }} plus {{ percenthealthdamage }}% max Health physical damage and resets the cooldown of Burrow / Un-burrow .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Perseverance
abilities.description: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.

abilities.name: Decisive Strike
abilities.description: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.
abilities.tooltip: Garen removes all Slowing effects on him and gains {{ movementspeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movementspeedduration }} second(s). His next Attack Silences for {{ silenceduration }} seconds and does {{ totaldamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Courage
abilities.description: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist by killing enemies. He may also activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction for a longer duration.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Garen has {{ resistsfortooltip }} bonus Armor and {{ resistsfortooltip }} bonus Magic Resist . Killing units permanently grants {{ resistgainonkilltooltip }} resists , up to a max of {{ resistmax }} . Active: Garen steels his courage for {{ drduration }} seconds, reducing incoming damage by {{ drpercent*100 }}%. He also gains {{ totalshield }} Shield and {{ upfronttenacity*100 }}% Tenacity for {{ upfrontduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Judgment
abilities.description: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Garen rapidly spins his sword for {{ duration }} seconds, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage {{ f1 }} times over the duration. The nearest enemy takes {{ nearestenemybonus*100 }}% increased damage . Champions hit by {{ stackstoshred }} strikes lose {{ shredamount*100 }}% Armor for {{ shredduration }} seconds. Recast : Garen ends this Ability early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Demacian Justice
abilities.description: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.
abilities.tooltip: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to slay his enemy, dealing {{ basedamage }} plus {{ executedamage*100 }}% missing Health true damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Junkyard Titan
abilities.description: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Flamespitter
abilities.description: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.
abilities.tooltip: Rumble ignites his flamethrower, dealing {{ flatdamage }} plus {{ healthdamage*100 }}% max Health magic damage over {{ flamespitterduration }} seconds, reduced to {{ minionmod*100 }}% against minions. Danger Zone: Damage is increased to {{ empowereddamage }} plus {{ empoweredhealth }} max Health . Percent damage is limited to {{ monstercap }} damage on Monsters. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Scrap Shield
abilities.description: Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed. While in Danger Zone, the shield strength and speed bonus is increased.
abilities.tooltip: Rumble tosses up a barrier, gaining {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration.1 }} seconds and {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} second. Danger Zone: The barrier grants {{ empoweredshield }} Shield and {{ empoweredms }} Move Speed instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Electro Harpoon
abilities.description: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.
abilities.tooltip: Rumble launches an electrified harpoon, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage , Slowing by {{ baseslowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds, and reducing the enemy's Magic Resist by {{ percmagicpen*100 }}% for {{ shredduration }} seconds. Hitting an enemy who's already Slowed by this Ability increases the Slow to {{ empoweredslowamount }}% and reduces the enemy's Magic Resist by {{ enhancedmagicpen*100 }}% Danger Zone: The harpoon deals {{ empdamage }} magic damage instead and the Slow and reduced Magic Resist are increased by 50%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: The Equalizer
abilities.description: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Rumble launches a line of rockets, creating a burning trail that lasts {{ trailduration }} seconds, Slowing by {{ slowamount }}% and dealing {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second. Rumble can control the direction of the trail by clicking and dragging while casting this Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.description: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.

abilities.name: Decimate
abilities.description: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle. Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.
abilities.tooltip: Darius hefts his axe then swings it around, dealing {{ bladedamage }} physical damage with the edge and {{ handledamage }} damage with the handle. Enemies hit with the handle do not take a Hemorrhage stack. Darius restores {{ e5 }}% missing Health per enemy champion and large jungle monster hit with the edge, up to a max of {{ e7 }}% .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Crippling Strike
abilities.description: Darius's next attack strikes an enemy's crucial artery. As they bleed out, their Move Speed is slowed.
abilities.tooltip: Darius' next Attack deals {{ empoweredattackdamage }} physical damage and Slows by {{ e2 }}% for {{ e5 }} second. This Ability refunds its Mana cost and reduces its Cooldown by {{ e3 }}% if it kills the target. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Apprehend
abilities.description: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor. When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Darius gains {{ e1 }}% Armor Penetration. Active: Darius hooks with his axe, Pulling , and Knocking Up and Slowing by {{ e2 }}% for {{ e3 }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Noxian Guillotine
abilities.description: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.
abilities.tooltip: Darius leaps to an enemy and strikes a lethal blow, dealing {{ damage }} true damage . For each Hemorrhage on the target, this Ability deals an additional {{ rdamagepercentperhemostack*100 }}% damage, up to a max of {{ maximumdamage }} damage . If this kills the target, Darius may Recast this Ability once within {{ rrecastduration }} seconds. At rank 3, this Ability has no Mana cost and kills refresh the Cooldown completely.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Daredevil Impulse
abilities.description: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up , she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.

abilities.name: Flair
abilities.description: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.
abilities.tooltip: Samira fires a shot, dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage to the first enemy hit. If this Ability is cast towards an enemy in melee range, Samira will instead slash with her sword, dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blade Whirl
abilities.description: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.
abilities.tooltip: Samira slashes around her for {{ slashduration }} seconds, damaging enemies twice for {{ damagecalc }} physical damage each and destroying any enemy missiles that enter the area. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wild Rush
abilities.description: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through and gaining Attack Speed. Killing an enemy champion refreshes this ability's cooldown.
abilities.tooltip: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through dealing {{ dashdamage }} magic damage and gaining {{ bonusattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds. If an enemy champion is killed within 3 seconds of Samira damaging them, This Ability's Cooldown is reset.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Inferno Trigger
abilities.description: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.
abilities.tooltip: Samira can only use this Ability if her current Style rating is S. Using this Ability consumes all Style rating. Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her 10 times over 2 seconds, each shot dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage and applying Life Steal at {{ lifestealmod*100 }}% effectiveness. Each shot can also critically strike. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ionian Fervor
abilities.description: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.

abilities.name: Bladesurge
abilities.description: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.
abilities.tooltip: Irelia dashes to an enemy, dealing {{ championdamage }} physical damage and restoring {{ healamount }} Health to herself. If the enemy dies or was Unsteady , the Cooldown is refreshed. Deals {{ miniondamage }} damage to minions.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Defiant Dance
abilities.description: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.
abilities.tooltip: Begin Charging: Irelia enters a defensive stance for up to {{ maxduration }} seconds, becoming unable to act but reducing physical damage taken by {{ finalphysicaldr }}% and magic damage taken by {{ finalmagicdr }}%. Release: Irelia lashes out with her blades, dealing {{ mindamagecalc }} physical damage increased up to {{ maxdamagecalc }} based on charge time.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Flawless Duet
abilities.description: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.
abilities.tooltip: Irelia throws a blade into the ground and can Recast for up to {{ buffduration }} seconds. Recast: Irelia throws a second blade, then they fly towards each other Stunning for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Champions and large jungle monsters become Unsteady for {{ markduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Vanguard's Edge
abilities.description: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.
abilities.tooltip: Irelia launches a barrage of blades, dealing {{ missiledamage }} magic damage and making champions and large jungle monsters Unsteady for {{ markduration }} seconds. The barrage explodes into a cage around the first champion hit for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. The cage deals {{ zonedamage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ ccduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Living Forge
abilities.description: Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources. Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere. Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.

abilities.name: Volcanic Rupture
abilities.description: Ornn slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.
abilities.tooltip: Ornn slams the ground, creating a fissure dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and Slowing by {{ e5 }}% for {{ e6 }} seconds. A pillar of rock forms at the fissure's end for {{ e3 }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bellows Breath
abilities.description: Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.
abilities.tooltip: Ornn stomps forward Unstoppably while breathing fire, dealing {{ maxpercenthpperticktooltip }}% max Health magic damage over {{ breathduration }} seconds. Enemies hit by the final bout of flame become Brittle for {{ brittleduration }} seconds. Immobilizing effects on Brittle targets have their duration increased by 30% and deal an additional {{ brittlepercentmaxhpcalc }} max Health magic damage . Ornn's Attacks against Brittle targets Knock them Back , dealing the additional damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Searing Charge
abilities.description: Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Ornn charges, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage . If Ornn rams into terrain, he creates a shockwave that Knocks Up enemies for {{ knockupduration }} seconds and applies the same damage to those not hit by the charge. Ornn's charge destroys magma pillars and terrain created by enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Call of the Forge God
abilities.description: Ornn summons a massive elemental at a location which travels toward him with increasing speed. Enemies run over by the elemental take damage, are slowed and are made Brittle. Ornn can recast the ability to charge into the elemental, redirecting it in the direction he hits it, causing the elemental to affect any enemies it runs over to be knocked up, dealing the same damage and re-applying Brittle.
abilities.tooltip: Ornn summons a massive lava elemental, which stampedes towards him, dealing {{ rdamagecalc }} magic damage , applying Brittle to, and Slowing enemies hit by {{ rslowpercentbasepremath }}% for {{ brittledurationtooltiponly }} seconds. Ornn can Recast to dash with a headbutt. If he dashes into the elemental, he redirects and empowers it, causing it to Knock Up the first champion for {{ rstunduration }} second and subsequent champions for {{ minstun }} seconds. The elemental also deals {{ rdamagecalc }} magic damage and reapplies Brittle .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Reign of Anger
abilities.description: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.

abilities.name: Cull the Meek
abilities.description: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.
abilities.tooltip: Renekton swings his blade, dealing {{ basicdamage }} physical damage and restoring {{ nonchamphealing }} Health per non-champion and {{ champhealing }} per champion hit. He also generates {{ minionfurygain }} Fury per non-champion and {{ championfurygain }} Fury per champion. Fury Bonus : Damage is increased to {{ empdamage }} physical damage and healing is increased to {{ empnonchamphealing }} Health against non-champions and {{ empchamphealing }} Health against champions. Does not generate any Fury .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ruthless Predator
abilities.description: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
abilities.tooltip: Renekton's next Attack strikes twice, Stunning for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing a total of {{ basictotaldamage }} physical damage . Hitting a champion generates an additional {{ bonusfuryvschamps }} Fury . Fury Bonus : Renekton Attacks 3 times instead, destroying Shields before dealing {{ emptotaldamage }} physical damage and Stunning for {{ enragedstunduration }} seconds. Does not generate any Fury .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Slice and Dice
abilities.description: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.
abilities.tooltip: Renekton dashes, dealing {{ basicdamage }} physical damage . He generates {{ minionragegeneration }} Fury per non-champion and {{ championragegeneration }} Fury per champion hit. Hitting at least one enemy allows Renekton to Recast this Ability once for {{ dicetimer }} seconds. Fury Bonus : The Recast dash deals {{ empdamage }} physical damage instead and removes {{ enragedarmorshred }}% Armor for {{ shredtimer }} seconds. Does not generate Fury .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dominus
abilities.description: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.
abilities.tooltip: Renekton surrounds himself with dark energies for {{ buffduration }} seconds, gaining {{ healthgain }} max Health and {{ furyoncast }} Fury . While active, he deals {{ totaldamagepersecond }} magic damage and gains {{ furypersecond }} Fury per second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.description: Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her. Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

abilities.name: Howling Gale
abilities.description: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.
abilities.tooltip: Janna summons a tornado that grows stronger over {{ maxduration }} seconds then blows along its path. It deals {{ minimumdamage }} - {{ maxdamage }} magic damage and Knocks Up for {{ baseknockup }} - {{ maxknockup }} seconds. The distance, damage, and Knock Up duration increase based on how much the tornado grew. Janna can Recast to send the tornado early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Zephyr
abilities.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Janna gains {{ totalms }} Move Speed and is Ghosted. Active: Janna's elemental strikes an enemy, Slowing them by {{ totalslow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} + {{ spell.tailwindself:bonusdamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Eye Of The Storm
abilities.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.
abilities.tooltip: Janna grants an ally champion or turret {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. While shielded, they gain {{ totalad }} Attack Damage . Janna refunds {{ ecdrefundforcc*100 }}% of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Monsoon
abilities.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.
abilities.tooltip: Janna summons a magical monsoon, Knocking Back nearby enemies then healing nearby allies for {{ totalheal }} Health over {{ e3 }} seconds. Moving or using an Ability ends the monsoon early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Battle Fury
abilities.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining {{ flatad }} Attack Damage plus {{ adperonepercentmissinghp }} per 1% missing Health. Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury , restoring {{ baseheal }} plus {{ healperfury }} Health per Fury .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mocking Shout
abilities.description: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.
abilities.tooltip: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by {{ adreduction*-1 }} for {{ reductionduration }} seconds. Enemy champions with their backs towards Tryndamere are Slowed by {{ slowpotency*-100 }}% for the same duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spinning Slash
abilities.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.
abilities.tooltip: Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and generating {{ nonchampfurygain }} Fury per enemy hit, increased to {{ champfurygain }} Fury against enemy champions. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ nonchampcdrefund }} second when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by {{ champcdrefund }} seconds when critically striking a champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Undying Rage
abilities.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.
abilities.tooltip: Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for {{ e3 }} seconds, refusing to be reduced below {{ e2 }} Health, and instantly gains {{ e1 }} Fury .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: New Destiny
abilities.description: Graves' shotgun has some unique properties. He must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back.

abilities.name: End of the Line
abilities.description: Graves fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain.
abilities.tooltip: Graves fires a powder round dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage . After 1 second or after colliding with terrain, it detonates, dealing {{ totaldetonationdamage }} physical damage along the travel path again and to enemies near the blast.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Smoke Screen
abilities.description: Graves fires a smoke canister at the target area creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.
abilities.tooltip: Graves creates a cloud of black smoke for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies inside by {{ e2 }}% and blocking their vision outside the area. The initial impact deals {{ impactdamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Quickdraw
abilities.description: Graves dashes forward gaining an Armor and Magic Resist boost for several seconds. If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.
abilities.tooltip: Graves dashes and reloads one Shell into his shotgun. He also gains a stack for {{ buffduration }} seconds (max {{ maxstacks }} stacks) or two stacks if he dashes towards an enemy champion. Stacks grant him {{ armorperstack }} Armor and {{ mrgrant }} Magic Resist . Stacks are refreshed when damaging a non-minion. Each bullet hit from Graves' Attacks reduces this Ability's Cooldown by {{ cooldownperhit }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Collateral Damage
abilities.description: Graves fires an explosive shell dealing heavy damage to the first champion it hits. After hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes dealing damage in a cone.
abilities.tooltip: Graves fires an explosive cartridge, blasting himself backwards. The cartridge deals {{ damage }} physical damage to the first enemy hit. After hitting an enemy champion or reaching the end of its range, the cartridge explodes outward, dealing {{ falloffdamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: League of Draven
abilities.description: Draven gains his fans' Adoration when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or tower. Killing enemy champions grants Draven bonus gold based on how much Adoration he has.

abilities.name: Spinning Axe
abilities.description: Draven's next attack will deal bonus physical damage. This axe will ricochet off the target high up into the air. If Draven catches it, he automatically readies another Spinning Axe. Draven can have two Spinning Axes at once.
abilities.tooltip: Draven readies a Spinning Axe , causing his next Attack to deal an additional {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and ricochet into the air. If Draven catches it, he readies another Spinning Axe . Draven can hold two Spinning Axes at once.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blood Rush
abilities.description: Draven gains increased Move Speed and Attack Speed. The Move Speed bonus decreases rapidly over its duration. Catching a Spinning Axe will refresh the cooldown of Blood Rush.
abilities.tooltip: Draven becomes Ghosted, gains {{ e2 }}% Move Speed decaying over {{ e3 }} seconds and {{ e4 }}% Attack Speed for {{ e5 }} seconds. When Draven catches a Spinning Axe , this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Stand Aside
abilities.description: Draven throws his axes, dealing physical damage to targets hit and knocking them aside. Targets hit are slowed.
abilities.tooltip: Draven chucks a sideways axe that deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage , Knocks Back , and Slows by {{ e2 }}% for {{ e3 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Whirling Death
abilities.description: Draven hurls two massive axes to deal physical damage to each unit struck. Whirling Death slowly reverses direction and returns to Draven after striking an enemy champion. Draven may also activate this ability while the axes are in flight to cause it to return early. Deals less damage for each unit hit and resets when the axes reverse direction. Executes enemies who have less health than Draven's number of Adoration stacks.
abilities.tooltip: Draven hurls two massive axes that deal {{ rcalculateddamage }} physical damage . Upon hitting a champion or Recasting , they reverse direction and return to Draven. The axes deal {{ rdamagereductionperhit*100 }}% less damage for each enemy hit, down to a minimum of {{ rmindamagepercent }}%. If Whirling Death would leave an enemy champion with less health than {{ rpassivestackscoefficient*100 }}% of Draven's current League of Draven stacks ({{ rpassivetruedamage }}), he will execute them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dragon Practice
abilities.description: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

abilities.name: Super Scorcher Breath
abilities.description: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.
abilities.tooltip: Smolder belches flame, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage + {{ spell.smolderp:passive_qdamageincrease }} magic damage . If the target dies, Smolder refunds {{ manarestore }} Mana , once per cast. Based on stacks of Dragon Practice , this Ability evolves to gain the following effects: {{ stacktier1 }} Stacks : Damages all enemies surrounding the target. {{ stacktier2 }} Stacks : Sends {{ tier2_numberofblowback }} explosions beyond the target that deal {{ tier2_blowbackpercentagedamage }}% of this Ability's damage. {{ stacktier3 }} Stacks : Burns the target, dealing {{ tier3_burn }} max Health true damage over {{ tier3_dotlength }} seconds. Enemy champions that drop below {{ tier3_executethreshold }} total health while burning are killed instantly.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Achooo!
abilities.description: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing {{ initialdamage }} physical damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing {{ explosiondamage }} physical + {{ spell.smolderp:passive_wdamageincrease }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
abilities.description: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.
abilities.tooltip: Smolder takes flight, gaining {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed and ignoring terrain for {{ duration }} seconds. While flying, Smolder bombards the lowest Health enemy {{ totalnumberofattacks }} (rounded down) times for {{ damageperhit }} physical damage + {{ spell.smolderp:ebonusdamage }} magic damage per hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: MMOOOMMMM!
abilities.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.
abilities.tooltip: Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage . Enemies in the center take {{ tooltiponly_totalsweetspotdamage }} physical damage instead and are Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Smolder's mom heals her son for {{ momhealcalc }} Health if she hits him.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Whisper
abilities.description: Jhin's hand cannon, Whisper, is a precise instrument designed to deal superior damage. It fires at a fixed rate and carries only four shots. Jhin imbues the final bullet with dark magics to critically strike and deal bonus execute damage. Whenever Whisper crits, it inspires Jhin with a burst of Move Speed.

abilities.name: Dancing Grenade
abilities.description: Jhin launches a magical cartridge at an enemy. It can hit up to four targets and gains damage each time it kills.
abilities.tooltip: Jhin launches a cartridge that deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage before bouncing to a nearby enemy that has not been hit yet. The cartridge can hit a maximum of {{ tooltipmaxtargetshit }} times. Enemies that die shortly after being hit increase the damage of subsequent hits by {{ percentamponkill*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Deadly Flourish
abilities.description: Jhin brandishes his cane, firing a single shot with incredible range. It pierces through minions and monsters, but stops on the first champion hit. If the target was recently struck by Jhin's allies, lotus traps, or damaged by Jhin, they are rooted.
abilities.tooltip: Jhin fires a long range shot dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to the first champion hit and other enemies along the way. If this skill strikes a champion that has been damaged by an allied champion within the last {{ spottingduration }} seconds, it will Root them for {{ rootduration }} seconds and grant Jhin Whisper 's Move Speed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Captive Audience
abilities.description: Jhin places an invisible lotus trap that blooms when walked over. It slows nearby enemies before dealing damage with an explosion of serrated petals. Beauty in Death - When Jhin kills an enemy champion, a lotus trap will bloom near their corpse.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Champions Jhin kills will create and detonate a Lotus Trap at their location. Active: Jhin places an invisible Lotus Trap for {{ trapduration }} minutes that creates a zone that Slows by {{ trapslowamount*100 }}% when stepped on by an enemy. After {{ trapdetonationtime }} seconds, the trap detonates, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . This ability has 2 charges ({{ ammorechargeratetooltip }} second refresh).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Curtain Call
abilities.description: Jhin channels, transforming Whisper into a shoulder-mounted mega-cannon. It is able to fire 4 super shots at extreme range that pierce through minions and monsters, but stop on the first champion impacted. Whisper cripples enemies hit, which slows them and deals execute damage. The 4th shot is perfectly crafted, epically powerful, and guaranteed to critically strike.
abilities.tooltip: Jhin sets up and channels, enabling him to fire 4 super shots, each dealing between {{ damagecalc }} and {{ maxincreasecalc }} physical damage to the first champion hit based on their percentage missing health and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. The fourth shot critically strikes for {{ fourthshotmultiplier*100 }}% damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mark of the Storm
abilities.description: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.

abilities.name: Thundering Shuriken
abilities.description: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits.
abilities.tooltip: Kennen throws a shuriken, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Electrical Surge
abilities.description: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Every 5th Attack deals an additional {{ totaldamagepassive }} magic damage . Active: Kennen sends out a blast of electricity, dealing {{ totaldamageactive }} magic damage to nearby enemies affected by Mark of the Storm . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Lightning Rush
abilities.description: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.
abilities.tooltip: Kennen turns into a ball of lightning, gaining {{ movementspeed*100 }}% Move Speed , dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies he passes through, and becoming Ghosted for {{ durationasball }} seconds. If Kennen damages at least one enemy, he gains {{ energyrefund }} Energy. After this ability ends, Kennen gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ durationafterball }} seconds. Kennen can Recast to end this Ability early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Slicing Maelstrom
abilities.description: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.
abilities.tooltip: Kennen unleashes a magical storm, dealing {{ pertickdamagecalculated }} magic damage to all nearby enemies every {{ kennenrtickrate }} seconds, and gaining {{ kennenrdefenses }} Armor and {{ kennenrdefenses }} Magic Resist for {{ kennenrduration }} seconds. Successive hits deal {{ damageamp*100 }}% increased damage for each hit the enemy has already suffered.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Serpentine Grace
abilities.description: Cassiopeia gains Move Speed per level, but she cannot purchase Boots items.

abilities.name: Noxious Blast
abilities.description: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion.
abilities.tooltip: Cassiopeia blasts noxious gas, Poisoning enemies and dealing {{ tooltiptotaldamage }} magic damage over {{ e2 }} seconds. Hitting a champion grants Cassiopeia {{ e3 }}% Move Speed decaying over {{ e4 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Miasma
abilities.description: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.
abilities.tooltip: Cassiopeia spews venom, leaving toxic clouds for {{ e4 }} seconds. Enemies in the clouds take {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second, are Poisoned , Grounded , and Slowed by {{ e2 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Twin Fang
abilities.description: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.
abilities.tooltip: Cassiopeia launches deadly fangs, dealing {{ basicdamage }} magic damage . If the enemy is Poisoned , they take an additional {{ bonuspoisoneddamage }} magic damage and Cassiopeia restores {{ healcalc }} Health , reduced to {{ healcalcminion }} Health against lane minions and small monsters. If this kills the target, Cassiopeia restores {{ cost }} Mana . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
abilities.description: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.
abilities.tooltip: Cassiopeia unleashes a petrifying gaze, dealing {{ rdamage }} magic damage and Stunning enemies facing her for {{ rccduration }} seconds. Enemies facing away are Slowed by {{ rslowpercent }}% decaying over the same duration instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Sunlight
abilities.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
abilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.
abilities.tooltip: Leona's next Attack Stuns for {{ e1 }} seconds and deals an additional {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.
abilities.tooltip: Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by {{ flatdamagereduction }} and gaining {{ bonusarmortooltip }} Armor and {{ bonusmrtooltip }} Magic Resist for {{ e3 }} seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional {{ e3 }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Zenith Blade
abilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.
abilities.tooltip: Leona thrusts with a sword of light, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage . The last champion struck will be Rooted for {{ e2 }} seconds and Leona will dash to them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Solar Flare
abilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.
abilities.tooltip: Leona calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing {{ explosioncalculateddamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ ccduration }} seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are Stunned instead of Slowed .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dauntless Instinct
abilities.description: K'Sante's Abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next Attack. When All Out, K'Sante deals more damage with all Attacks and Abilities.

abilities.name: Ntofo Strikes
abilities.description: K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line. On hit, grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in. When All Out, cooldown is reduced.
abilities.tooltip: K'Sante slams his weapon, dealing {{ basedamage }} physical damage and Slowing enemies by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s. If he hits, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for {{ recastwindow }} seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that Stuns and Pulls enemies for {{ stunduration }} second. All Out : Cooldown is reduced by {{ rcooldownreduction.0*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Path Maker
abilities.description: K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies. When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.
abilities.tooltip: K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for {{ mindurationtooltip }}-{{ maxduration.1 }}s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by {{ damagereduction*100 }}%. Then, he rams forward, dealing {{ basedamage }} + {{ totalmaxhealthdamage }} max Health physical damage . Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for {{ minknockbackduration }}-{{ maxknockbackduration }}s (based on charge time). All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional {{ rdamageincreasemin*100 }}-{{ rdamageincreasemax*100 }}% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to {{ rdamagereduction*100 }}% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Footwork
abilities.description: K'Sante dashes and gains a shield. If targeting an ally, K'Sante dashes to the ally with increased range and both gain a shield. When All Out, cooldown is reduced and speed is increased.
abilities.tooltip: K'Sante dashes, gaining {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. If dashing to an ally, the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally is also Shielded . All Out : Cooldown is decreased by {{ cooldownmodao*100 }}% and dash speed is increased.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: All Out
abilities.description: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.
abilities.tooltip: K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing {{ basedamage }} physical damage , then dashes behind them and goes All Out for {{ alloutduration }}s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for {{ totaldamageslamdown }} physical damage . While All Out , K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed , {{ armorpenpercent*100 }}% Bonus Armor Penetration, and {{ omnivamp*100 }}% Omnivamp , but loses {{ healthlost*100 }}% max Health , {{ defenseslost*100 }}% Bonus Armor , and {{ defenseslost*100 }}% Bonus Magic Resistance .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Leverage
abilities.description: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Handshake
abilities.description: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.
abilities.tooltip: Renata sends out a missile from her arm, Rooting the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} second and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Recast: Renata Pulls the enemy in a direction, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies they are thrown into and Stunning for {{ stunduration }} seconds if the thrown enemy is a champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bailout
abilities.description: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.
abilities.tooltip: Renata infuses an ally champion, granting {{ ascalc }} Attack Speed and {{ mscalc }} Move Speed towards enemies, increasing to {{ finalascalc }} Attack Speed and {{ finalmscalc }} Move Speed over {{ duration }} seconds. Takedowns refresh the duration of the buff. If the ally would die, they instead return to full Health, which then decays over 3 seconds. If they get a Takedown while decaying, they will be set to {{ triumphpercent }}% max Health and stop decaying. The Champion's death can be delayed by healing or similar effects while in the decaying state, but cannot be prevented unless the Champion gets a Takedown. Champions can only delay their death once. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Loyalty Program
abilities.description: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.
abilities.tooltip: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing surrounding enemies and enemies hit by 30% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Allies hit gain {{ shieldcalc }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Hostile Takeover
abilities.description: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.
abilities.tooltip: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, Berserking enemies for {{ berserkduration }} seconds, causing them to Attack the nearest unit, prioritizing their allies. While Berserk , enemies gain {{ bonusattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Granite Shield
abilities.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

abilities.name: Seismic Shard
abilities.description: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
abilities.tooltip: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing {{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ e2 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Malphite also steals the amount Slowed , gaining it as Move Speed for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Malphite gains {{ bonusarmorpassive*100 }}% Armor (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f1 }}) . This effect is increased to {{ bonusarmorpassive*300 }}% (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f2 }}) while Granite Shield is active. Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional {{ totalbonusdamage }} physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals {{ thunderclapsplash }} physical damage in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks for the next {{ thunderclapbuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
abilities.tooltip: Malphite slams the ground, dealing {{ edamagecalc }} magic damage and reducing Attack Speed by {{ asreduction }}% for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
abilities.tooltip: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite Knocks Up for {{ knockupduration }} seconds and deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mark of the Kindred
abilities.description: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

abilities.name: Dance of Arrows
abilities.description: Kindred tumbles and shoots up to three arrows at nearby targets.
abilities.tooltip: Kindred vaults, firing an arrow at up to 3 enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and gaining {{ totalqattackspeed }} Attack Speed for {{ e8 }} seconds. While inside of Wolf's Frenzy , this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to {{ e4 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wolf's Frenzy
abilities.description: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him.  Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Kindred gains stacks as they move and attack. At 100 stacks, Kindred's next Attack restores up to {{ attackheal }} Health based on their missing Health. Active: Kindred claims a territory, ordering Wolf to bite at the last enemy Lamb Attacked. Wolf's bites deal {{ basewolfdamage }} plus {{ percentwolfdamage }} current Health magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mounting Dread
abilities.description: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.
abilities.tooltip: Kindred weakens an enemy, Slowing them by {{ totalslow }}% for {{ slowduration }} second. Kindred's third Attack against the target within {{ totalduration }} seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing {{ basebitedamage }} plus {{ percentbitedamage }} missing Health physical damage . Wolf's pounce critically strikes for {{ basebitedamage }} plus {{ critdamage }} missing Health physical damage instead if they are below {{ healththreshold }} Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Lamb's Respite
abilities.description: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.
abilities.tooltip: Kindred blesses the ground for {{ e2 }} seconds, allowing no unit, ally, enemy, or neutral to die while inside. Upon reaching 10% Health, units can't be damaged or healed while still inside the zone. When the blessing ends, all units inside heal for {{ e1 }} Health .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.
abilities.tooltip: Olaf throws an axe, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for up to {{ e3 }} seconds (based on distance travelled). Champions hit lose {{ shredamount*100 }}% Armor for {{ debuffduration }} seconds. If Olaf picks up the axe, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to {{ tooltipcdrefund }} seconds, or fully refunded if {{ tooltipcdrefund }} seconds has elapsed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tough It Out
abilities.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.
abilities.tooltip: Olaf gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ duration }} seconds, and {{ baseshield }} plus {{ shieldpercmissinghp*100 }}% missing Health Shield (up to a maximum of {{ maxshieldcalc }} Shield below {{ thresholdformax*100 }}% Health) for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Reckless Swing
abilities.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.
abilities.tooltip: Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing {{ totaldamage }} true damage . If the enemy dies, the cost is refunded. Attacks lower the Cooldown of this Ability by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds when attacking monsters.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ragnarok
abilities.description: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Olaf gains {{ resists }} Armor and {{ resists }} Magic Resist . Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them for {{ duration }} seconds. While active, Olaf gains {{ ad }} Attack Damage . Hitting a champion with an Attack or Reckless Swing extends the duration by {{ durationextension }} seconds. Additionally, Olaf gains {{ haste*100 }}% Move Speed towards enemy champions for {{ hasteduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ki Barrier
abilities.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

abilities.name: Twilight Assault
abilities.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.
abilities.tooltip: Shen recalls his Spirit Blade . Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by {{ e4 }}% while moving away from Shen for the next {{ e5 }} seconds. Additionally, Shen's next {{ e3 }} Attacks deal an additional {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ basepercenthealth }} max Health magic damage . If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade , the damage is increased to {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ emppercenthealth }} max Health magic damage and he gains {{ e9 }}% Attack Speed for those Attacks.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
abilities.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.
abilities.tooltip: Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for {{ e1 }} seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked. If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to {{ e2 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shadow Dash
abilities.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers {{ energyrefund }} Energy . Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for {{ ccduration }} seconds and dealing {{ tauntdamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Stand United
abilities.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
abilities.tooltip: Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between {{ shield }} and {{ maxshield }} Shield based on their missing Health for {{ shieldduration }} seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for {{ channelduration }} seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his Spirit Blade .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ravenous Flock
abilities.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

abilities.name: Death's Hand
abilities.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.
abilities.tooltip: Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing {{ initialdamage }} magic damage plus {{ extraboltdamage }} magic damage per bolt past the first (max {{ maxdamage }} magic damage ).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Vision of Empire
abilities.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.
abilities.tooltip: Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slow*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for {{ revealduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Nevermove
abilities.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.
abilities.tooltip: Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal {{ secondarydamage }} magic damage and Root enemies in the area for {{ rootduration }} seconds. Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Demonic Ascension
abilities.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip: Swain frees the demon, which deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage and drains {{ healingcalc }} Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns. After {{ demonflarecastdelay }} seconds and every {{ demonflarecooldowntooltip }} seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals {{ demonflaredamagetotal }} magic damage and Slows enemies by {{ demonflareslowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ demonflareslowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Damnation
abilities.description: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

abilities.name: Death Sentence
abilities.description: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.
abilities.tooltip: Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for {{ tauntlength }} seconds. The scythe does {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration. Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy. If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by {{ hitbonuscooldown }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dark Passage
abilities.description: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.
abilities.tooltip: Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh. The lantern also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Flay
abilities.description: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between {{ pattackdamagemin }} and {{ pattackdamagemax }} magic damage . Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by {{ e2 }}% for {{ e4 }} second and take {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: The Box
abilities.description: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.
abilities.tooltip: Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, Slowing champions by {{ e3 }}% for {{ e2 }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and Slow for half duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Double Strike
